name: mentat
description: Manage small inference clusters and route model endpoints with a lightweight replacement for vLLM's Ray executor dependencies.
compatibility: vLLM Ray executor shim; OpenAI-compatible model routing; HTTP/MCP router.
limitations: Implements the Ray functionality used by vLLM, not the full Ray API.
rust/Cargo.toml declares MIT OR Apache-2.0, while the python/ directory carries no separate license file and installs under the ray package namespace.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
Python shim package metadata installing under the ray package namespace without a separate license declaration.
